subject.title: [Feature]: CLI command to list pending exec approval requests

question: Should the first CLI surface remain read-only, or may it also submit approval decisions and support live watch behavior?
rationale: Listing is bounded visibility, while resolution and watch add authority, event-lifecycle, and monitoring semantics beyond the original request.

options.title: List first
options.body: Ship one-shot table and JSON listing under the existing approval scope, leaving resolution and watch for separate reviewed work.

options.title: Adopt broader PR
options.body: Keep listing and resolution together only after live Gateway proof and explicit approval of the expanded authorization boundary.

options.title: UI only
options.body: Decline a runtime CLI surface and keep pending approval inspection in authenticated UI clients.

recommendation.title: List first
recommendation.body: Ship one-shot table and JSON listing under the existing approval scope, leaving resolution and watch for separate reviewed work.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest feature-history and recent product-direction evidence for the approval lifecycle and CLI scope.
